question: Does the byte-identical current InputOwner v10 verify release of an admitted held key after an observed A-to-B X11 focus transfer, before B receives another matching KeyPress?
hypothesis: With autorepeat established independently, the owner detects the focus change on its bounded queue wait, emits KeyRelease, and verifies the key is absent from the X server keymap before B receives an additional matching KeyPress.
fixture: One private Xvfb 800x600x24 server, two bare X windows, Python 3.12 system python-xlib, actual current input_owner_v10.py; no WM, model, app, or game.

design.control: XTEST key-down on A held 160ms, collect matching KeyPress events, send KeyRelease, verify query_keymap reports key up
design.trial: Owner admits one key-down on A; external client moves and reads focus as B; owner records focus_changed release and empty keymap; B event pump spans observed focus through release sync plus 100ms
design.output: raw.json plus independent classification.json, error.txt and xvfb.stderr when applicable

primary_decision.scoped_pass: positive control succeeds; A-to-B focus transfer is read back; owner logs focus_changed release; server keymap is empty; B event-pump coverage is complete; zero matching B KeyPress received between observed B focus and owner release sync return
primary_decision.counterexample: one or more matching B KeyPress events are received after observed B focus and before owner release sync return
primary_decision.hold: release verification, focus observation, source identity, event order, or event-pump coverage is missing or inconsistent
primary_decision.stop: positive repeat control does not show at least two presses and a verified release

H: Observed focus loss leads the current owner to verified release before the new focus receives autorepeat.
T: One control and one owner-integrated focus transfer, one invocation, no retries.
D: Classify raw.json independently; do not trust a candidate status label.
C: Private Linux Xvfb, Python Xlib, current source hashes retained in raw.json.
U: Single scheduler-sensitive Xvfb trial on one WSL host; narrow event-delivery mechanism only.
shared_resource_rule: Do not execute until WSL shared allocation owner explicitly clears CPU/Xvfb lane; current observations show other live workers and Xvfb sessions.
claim_boundary: No gameplay, MAP01, real desktop, product reliability or general autorepeat safety claim.
